svg.title: Comparison diagram of text and image inputs mapped by functions to embedding points in two latent circles
svg.desc: Inventory: left block contains two text input boxes x_i^(1), x_i^(2), two upward arrows to two parallelogram function frames f_i, dashed diagonal arrows converging to one red point inside a gray circular embedding region. Right block mirrors this structure for image inputs x_j^(1), x_j^(2), two upward arrows to f_j parallelograms, dashed diagonal arrows to two nearby red points inside a second gray circular embedding region. The two right photo inputs are first constructed with native SVG draft content and then replaced by confirmed SAM photo assets P001 and P002 while keeping outer colored borders and labels.

g.data-plus-keeps: f07 f08 lbl_xj1 lbl_xj2 arr_xj1_to_fj1 arr_xj2_to_fj2
g.desc: Original Figure Object - Constructed Element ID - SAM Asset ID mappings: right first Labrador image x_j^(1) - draft_photo_p001 - asset_sam_region_000008; right second Labrador image x_j^(2) - draft_photo_p002 - asset_sam_region_000009. Assets match the photo regions identified on the overview board and preserve source_crop coordinates.
